# Scientific thinking. Mathematical modelling. Data and AI.

I work across disciplines and engineering contexts: from mathematical and environmental modelling in research settings to software delivery, industrial Data Science, and evaluation of AI systems.

This portfolio is a curated, evidence-led account of that path. It connects scientific questions, methods, implementation choices, technologies, and evidence. It is not a catalogue of every technology encountered: each project is described at the level supported by a publication, public repository, or clearly stated professional experience. Private industrial work is summarised without exposing proprietary code, data, or implementation details.

## A multidisciplinary profile

- **Mathematics and science:** partial differential equations, applied mathematics, statistics, fluid mechanics, environmental dispersion, and urban hydrology.
- **Research and experimentation:** problem formulation, model assumptions, numerical modelling, evaluation protocols, baselines, error analysis, and interpretation of results.
- **Software engineering:** application development across front-end and back-end systems, maintainable code, testing, integration, and deployment environments.
- **Data and AI:** statistical analysis, classical machine learning, LLM/NLP and generative AI, benchmark design, and model evaluation.

The connecting skill is adaptation: understanding the scientific or product problem first, then selecting and implementing an appropriate method within the constraints of the environment.

## Selected evidence

- [Reduced-Order Modelling of Dispersion (2008)](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-1-4020-8758-5_14) — applied mathematics and environmental modelling.
- [Similitude généralisée et modélisation géométrique à complexité réduite (2006)](https://comptes-rendus.academie-sciences.fr/mecanique/articles/10.1016/j.crme.2006.06.007/) — reduced-complexity modelling.
- [TEB-Veg hydrological-modelling paper (2018)](https://gmd.copernicus.org/articles/11/4175/2018/) — a concrete bridge between scientific modelling and environmental processes.
- [Wiki Knowledge](https://github.com/JM-Brun/wiki-knowledge) — a public Python project exploring source-grounded knowledge organisation, validation, and lexical retrieval.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/brunjm/) — current professional profile and full career timeline.

For private industrial projects, the portfolio describes the problem, scope, general approach, and transferable lessons only where disclosure is appropriate. No confidential source code or data is published here.
